verdict.rationale: Grok's own built-in connectors (Gmail/Calendar, Google Drive, Teams, Salesforce) and custom MCP connectors let it search and read a user's data on demand inside chat, where the model can reason over it. However, the docs describe data access and actions, not insight or suggestion generation from that data, so the core of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights or proactive suggestions derived from user data, examples of analysis or summarization over connected data, and independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality on personal or business data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Connect your tools so Grok can reach your email, files, and calendar right inside a chat.
Each one authenticates via OAuth, so you connect once and Grok can access your data on demand.
The Google Drive connector lets Grok search, read, and manage files in your Google Drive.
Expose any internal API, database, or SaaS tool to Grok.
